# Office Open XML fixtures (spike 11)

Real files for the upload profile's Office Open XML rule (`apps/cms/src/utils/upload-ooxml.ts`; deep-dive decision 06 §E1, owner amendment 2; batch 16 lane 16A). `upload-ooxml.test.ts` gives every file here a verdict, and checks that none carries personal data: every `dc:creator` and `cp:lastModifiedBy` is empty or `sinnlos fixture`, and `Company` and `Manager` are empty.

The built cases (disguises, XML-subset and layout cases, minimal packages) are not files: the suites build them with the zip writer of `apps/cms/src/integration/upload.test.helper.ts`.

## Producers

| File                                                                             | Producer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Verdict        |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| `word-desktop.docx`                                                              | Microsoft Word for Microsoft 365, desktop, Windows (16.0.20430), saved through COM with "remove personal information"                                                                                                                                                                                                           | accepted, DOCX |
| `excel-desktop.xlsx`                                                             | Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365, desktop (16.0.20430), the same way                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | accepted, XLSX |
| `powerpoint-desktop.pptx`                                                        | Microsoft PowerPoint for Microsoft 365, desktop (16.0.20430), the same way                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | accepted, PPTX |
| `word-desktop.docm`, `.dotx`, `.dotm`                                            | Word desktop, "Save as" macro-enabled document (no VBA project), template, macro-enabled template                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | refused        |
| `excel-desktop.xlsm`, `.xlsb`, `.xltx`, `.xltm`, `.xlam`                         | Excel desktop, "Save as" macro-enabled workbook (no VBA project), binary workbook, template, macro-enabled template, add-in                                                                                                                                                                                                     | refused        |
| `excel-desktop-xlm.xlsm`                                                         | Excel desktop: a workbook with an Excel 4.0 macro sheet (`xl/macrosheets/sheet1.xml`, no VBA project)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | refused        |
| `powerpoint-desktop.pptm`, `.potx`, `.potm`, `.ppsx`, `.ppsm`                    | PowerPoint desktop, "Save as" macro-enabled presentation (no VBA project), template, macro-enabled template, slideshow, macro-enabled slideshow                                                                                                                                                                                 | refused        |
| `word-desktop-vba.docm`, `excel-desktop-vba.xlsm`, `powerpoint-desktop-vba.pptm` | The macro-enabled desktop file plus a VBA part (`vbaProject.bin`, an OLE header only), its `application/vnd.ms-office.vbaProject` Default and the `vbaProject` relationship, re-zipped by Python 3.14 `zipfile` (deflate). This machine's Office does not grant VBA project access to automation, so no real macro was written. | refused        |
| `python-zipfile.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`                                          | The desktop file's parts re-zipped by Python 3.14 `zipfile` (deflate, seekable): the layout openpyxl, python-docx and python-pptx write                                                                                                                                                                                         | accepted       |
| `python-zipfile-streamed.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`                                 | The same parts written by `zipfile` to an unseekable stream: data descriptors with signature (flag bit 3) and `[Content_Types].xml` as the last entry, the layout of streaming writers                                                                                                                                          | accepted       |

The re-zipped and derived files carry `sinnlos fixture` as author; the desktop files carry an empty author (Office's "remove personal information").

## Not covered here

LibreOffice (not installed on the machine that made these files), Google Sheets and Slides, and Microsoft 365 for the web. The owner provides files from those producers for the combined rehearsal (batch 16 plan §6).

## Regenerating

Office desktop through COM (PowerShell, `Excel.Application`, `PowerPoint.Application`, `Word.Application`, `RemovePersonalInformation`, `SaveAs` with the format codes 51/52/50/54/53/55, 24-29, 16/13/14/15), then a Python stdlib script for the derived and re-zipped files. Keep every file under 50 KB, check the personal-data test, and give a new file its verdict in `upload-ooxml.test.ts`.
